name: Openmind Robotics
summary: Openmind Robotics, operated by Qizhi (Wuhu) Intelligent Robot Co., Ltd., develops a general technology platform for intelligent robots. Established in 2024 by EFORT and investment partners, the Wuhu company combines its Openmind OS, Modou development tools and Dayan data platform with the Yobot robot family. Its humanoid platforms support motion research and physical work, including demonstrations of retail shelf stocking.
